decisions.reason: ID Vault is a core digital identity feature with a dedicated launch announcement, making discontinuation unlikely.
The identity-bound digital payment wallet supports the super-app payment ecosystem, so it is retained despite limited web presence.
The NFC tag login authenticator is a niche, hardware-dependent component with higher strategic uncertainty, but it is kept for now.
The secure payment and wallet framework is central to the firm's payment capabilities and has its own product page, indicating strong commitment.
The multi-service mobile app platform is a core part of the super-app strategy, so it is retained even if currently under-promoted.
The application shielding security library is a differentiated security offering with a dedicated page, making it highly likely to stay.
